title: McFarlane Green Goblin Platinum Marvel 1:10 Statue - New
descriptionText:
New In Hand!

This McFarlane Toys statue is a must-have for any Marvel fan. The Green Goblin Platinum Edition Marvel Cover 1:10 statue is a stunning addition to any collection. With intricate details and a precise scale of 1:10, this figure is perfect for display.

Featuring the Green Goblin from Amazing Spider-Man, this statue is perfect for fans of the Marvel universe. The McFarlane Toys brand is known for its high-quality collectibles, and this statue is no exception. Whether you're a seasoned collector or just starting out, this figure is sure to impress.
